name: Legacy system
summary: Forever's seasonal replacement for achievements. Complete Legacy Challenges to earn Legacy Points (capped at 16 per season at launch), spend them in three trees for permanent bonuses, and unlock seasonal cosmetics at 15, 25, 40 and 55 total points.
steps: Unlock it with level 25 or 150 in a crafting profession (press Y)
1 point each for levels 25, 45 and 60 on every class
1 point each for 150, 225 and 300 in Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking or Tailoring
PvP: honour ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14; Exalted with a battleground faction (one point total); weeks 4, 7 and 10 of the Field of Honor Journey
Explore Azeroth, and the An Earnest Proposition to Saving the Best for Last questline
1 point per dungeon group: Novice, Experienced and Master Spelunker
1 point per raid fully cleared: Hyjal Summit, Barrow Deeps, Onyxia's Lair
talents: Professions: Working Overtime (+4% skill-up chance x5), Bountiful Harvest (+20% Scarce materials x5), Luremaster, Performance Bonus, Bartering (-5% vendor prices x2), Master Chef, Dedicated Study. Adventure: Well Rested (+4% rested gain and cap x5), Thrill of Adventure, Field Medicine, Field Guide, Talented (talents from level 9, down to 5), High Alert, Frequent Flier (50% cheaper, 20% faster flights). Resourcefulness: Gourmand (+33% food buff duration), The Quick and the Dead, Reinforce, Diplomat (+2% reputation x5), Permanence (+50% class buff and camp duration), For Great Honor, Reagent Economy (no vendor reagents).
tips: Claim cosmetic rewards from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet
Hardcore points work on normal characters, not the other way round
Maxing the system is a long-term goal, not a per-season one

name: Riding & mounts
summary: Mounts unlock at level 40 with one universal Riding skill from your own race's trainer; riding another race's mount needs Exalted with them.
steps: Apprentice Riding: level 40, 100g training, 20g mount, 60% speed
Journeyman Riding: level 60, 1,000g training, 200g mount, 100% speed
Honored with your home faction: 10% off training and mounts
trainers: Randal Hunter, Elwynn Forest (84, 65) · Jartsam, Darnassus (38, 16) · Ultham Ironhorn, Dun Morogh (64, 50) · Binjy Featherwhistle, Dun Morogh (49, 48) · Genn Fairweather, Zephras Isle (54, 81) for both Skyborne · Kildar, Orgrimmar (69, 13) · Xar'Ti, Durotar (55, 76) · Kar Stormsinger, Mulgore (47, 62) · Velma Warnam, Tirisfal Glades (60, 52)
tips: Paladins and Warlocks get riding and their class mounts through class quests
Humans have a second mount vendor in Menethil Harbor (Wetlands 9, 54)

name: Weapon trainers
summary: Weapon Masters teach the weapon skills your class can use. Most skills cost 10 silver; Polearms need level 20 and cost 1 gold.
trainers: Ilyenia Moonfire (Darnassus, Warrior's Terrace): bows, daggers, fist, staves, thrown · Buliwyf Stonehand (Ironforge Military Ward): fist, guns, axes, maces · Bixi Wobblebonk (Ironforge): crossbows, daggers, thrown · Woo Ping (Stormwind Trade District): crossbows, daggers, swords, polearms, staves · Sayoc (Orgrimmar Valley of Honor): bows, daggers, fist, axes, staves, thrown · Hanashi (Orgrimmar): bows, axes, staves, thrown · Ansekhwa (Thunder Bluff Lower Rise): guns, maces, staves · Archibald (Undercity War Quarter): crossbows, daggers, swords, polearms
tips: Wands are automatic for Mages, Priests and Warlocks
Some classes can use weapons Classic didn't allow, e.g. Rogues with one-handed axes
Druids get Feral Combat from level 1

name: Experience & Rested XP
summary: XP comes from quests, kills, exploring and dungeons; level 60 takes 4,084,700 XP in total. Rested XP, Well Fed food, the Camp Tent and the Cozy Sleeping Bag all boost it and stack.
steps: Grey quests (5+ levels below) give 10-20% less XP per extra level
Grey mobs give no XP; first tag gets credit
Full 5-player group: kill XP divided by 5 and multiplied by 1.4 (100 XP solo = 28 each)
Quest turn-in XP isn't reduced by grouping
Rested XP doubles kill XP; builds 5% of a level per 8 hours in inns/cities, capped at 150% (about 10 days)
Well Rested Legacy talent: +4% rest gain and cap per rank
Well Fed: +5% kill XP for about 15 minutes (lost on death)
Cozy Sleeping Bag: up to 3% XP, kept through death
Camp Tent: 1-hour buff that persists through death
High-level group members now carry stronger XP penalties in dungeons
tips: Log out in inns or cities
Pick up dungeon quests before going in
Keep Cooking levelled for constant Well Fed
